verdict.rationale: Mirrors' site lists LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI and other frameworks and claims it 'works with any agent framework'. The documented setup is manual, though: you install an npm package and connect prompt and capture hooks, and no prebuilt per-framework instrumentation is described. Missing for 10: documented drop-in integrations for LangChain and other frameworks, any mention of the OpenAI SDK or Vercel AI SDK, integration setup docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK
